engagement.interaction_backstory: He started a men's group of thirty out of his living room and built its whole rhythm on music he found here. He is organized, relentless and generous, and he has personally put your catalog in front of more men than your marketing has. He wants a shareable group playlist and there is not one.

depth.core_contradiction: Built a room where thirty men tell the truth, and chairs it so tightly that nobody can say anything he did not schedule.
depth.wound: Nobody built a room like that for him at twenty-two and he nearly did not make it through.
depth.longing: A seat in the circle instead of the chair at the front.
depth.faith_journey: Came to faith at twenty-three, after; the intensity of a convert with a decade of discipline behind it now.
depth.voice_fingerprint: "Real talk"; frames everything as a plan with three parts; says "I hear you" and then keeps going.
depth.open_doubt: Whether he is discipling men or managing them.

social_graph.note: tells him the truth and he does not always take it
his men; four of them would be homeless without the group

depth.emotional_weather_default: Driven and up; short with people on Thursdays.
depth.daily_texture: Clinic all day, the living room chairs on Tuesday, a spreadsheet of thirty men and their situations.
depth.sensory_anchor: A man twice his age putting a hand on his shoulder in a parking lot in 2015.
depth.living_arc: The group is bigger than his living room and he cannot delegate.
